text:
GTA 6 Gameplay & Full Map Leak Online - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Grand Theft Auto 6 has suffered a string of devastating leaks recently, with reportedly the full map and more gameplay being shown. The group behind the leaks, CyberLeek, has also published a manifesto railing against excessive monetization in games, and the death of physical media. The group has promised more leaks until their grievances are addressed. The leaks come a little over a week until the official in-depth reveal from Rockstar and Netflix, who will carry the livestream exclusively for six hours. In other news, Horizon Hunters Gathers, the multiplayer-centric spinoff of the Horizon games from Sony, is reportedly being completely retooled following negative player feedback. The game is not officially released and is undergoing public testing. And in related news, Horizon 3 is in development but is years away and only has a small team assigned to it.

Whalefall - Official Trailer (2026) Josh Brolin, Emily Rudd, Austin Abrams
Don't miss the Official Trailer for Whalefall, an action-adventure thriller film distributed by 20th Century Studios. Experience an intense escape from an unlikely place in Whalefall, in theaters on October 16.

Whalefall follows a scuba diver who, while looking for his father's remains, is swallowed by an 80-foot, 60-ton sperm whale and has just one hour to get out before his oxygen runs out.

Whalefall stars Austin Abrams, Josh Brolin, Elisabeth Shue, Jane Levy, Emily Rudd, John Ortiz, and more. The film is directed by Brian Duffield and written by Daniel Kraus and Brian Duffield.

Whalefall is in theaters on October 16.

text:
Silver Pines Preview: It Plays and Looks Like If Alan Wake Were Made in the ‘90s
Silver Pines' pixelated art is surprisingly fluid and expressive, the voice acting is off-putting and eerie, and every part of the small town you find yourself in is just so ominous and filled with little hair-raising details all over. It’s utterly Lynchian stuff if I ever saw it, and we really like what we've seen so far. Previewed by Travis Northup

Honeycomb: The World Beyond - Official New Release Date Trailer
Explore the vibrant sci-fi planet of Honeycomb: The World Beyond in this trailer for the upcoming survival sandbox game developed by Frozen Way. Meet strange creatures, check out gameplay, and learn about your mission in this new trailer. Honeycomb: The World Beyond will be available on Steam, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on September 8, 2026. A demo will be available on Steam on August 31, 2026.

In Honeycomb: The World Beyond, step into the astro boots of Hennessy, a pioneer forging an expedition on an uninhabited, mysterious planet that could be the key to saving mankind. Explore the world of Sota7 and uncover its secrets. From calm forests and vibrant jungles to vast fields spread at the foot of a mysterious volcano, every trek through its diverse terrain is sure to leave a lasting impression. Carve out a home for yourself and use that safe space to further your research. Honeycomb: The World Beyond was developed with NVIDIA features integrated into the experience, such as DLSS 4.5 with Ray Reconstruction, Multi Frame Generation, and more. Play your part in saving the Earth’s ecosystem through experimenting with innovative bioengineering mechanics on Sota7.

author: IGN YouTube
text:
Wildwood - Official Trailer (2026) Carey Mulligan, Richard E. Grant, Mahershala Ali
How far would you go for those you love? Watch the new trailer for Wildwood, an upcoming animated film from LAIKA Studios (the makers of Coraline). Wildwood features the voice talents of Carey Mulligan, Peyton Elizabeth Lee, Jacob Tremblay, Richard E. Grant, Awkwafina, Amandla Stenberg, Tom Waits, Charlie Day, Blythe Danner, Arthur Knight, Maya Erskine, Jake Johnson, Tantoo Cardinal, Rob Delaney, Jemaine Clement, Marc Evan Jackson, Len Cariou, Ólafur Darri Ólafsson, with Angela Bassett and Mahershala Ali. 

From the makers of Coraline, Wildwood is a sweeping, darkly magical adventure about Prue, a young girl who journeys into a hidden forest to rescue her younger brother. Along the way she encounters warring factions, extraordinary creatures, and a world unlike anything she's ever known. 

Wildwood is directed and produced by Travis Knight (Masters of the Universe, Kubo and the Two Strings). It is written by Chris Butler.

Inspired by Colin Meloy’s acclaimed novel, Wildwood brings an expansive fantasy world to the screen through LAIKA’s singular approach to stop-motion filmmaking. Characters, environments and intricate details are physically crafted and animated by hand, frame by frame, creating a world that feels both fantastical and unmistakably tangible.

Wildwood opens in theaters nationwide on October 23, 2026.
